tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: The table: full-screen background behind everything. Wash it with a region-* tint at 18–24% as a radial glow behind the Encounter, never flat purple stone.

tokens.name: stone
tokens.usage: Panels and trays: the Action Set tray, Result and Prepare panels, the top bar, lists. Default surface for parchment text.

tokens.name: stone-raised
tokens.usage: Secondary buttons, tabs, list rows on hover, chips. The 'slab you can press'.

tokens.name: well
tokens.usage: Sunken card slots and empty wells inside a stone panel (the empty Reserve slot, hand spaces). Always paired with an inset shadow.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairline dividers inside panels (table rows, section rules). Not for borders that carry meaning; it is 1.5:1 on stone by design.

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: Meaningful control borders and the etched outline of panels and unselected buttons: 3.5:1 on stone, 4:1 on ground.

tokens.name: parchment
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on ground, stone, stone-raised and well (10.9–15.2:1). Lifted straight from the peach highlights in the enemy and dragon art.

tokens.name: parchment-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: captions, column heads, flavour lines, inactive tab labels. On ground, stone and stone-raised (5.9–7.9:1).

tokens.name: parchment-faint
tokens.usage: Disabled labels only (Play before the set is full, Confirm 3/4). Deliberately below 4.5:1: it must read as unavailable; pair it with the disabled slab, never use it for live text.

tokens.name: brass
tokens.usage: Primary action fill (Play, Play again, Continue), the selected border on tabs, slots and cards, slot-header text when that slot is the active target. As text, on stone (8.2:1) and stone-raised (7:1).

tokens.name: brass-bright
tokens.usage: Numbers that are rewards: Score, XP, the XP star, place 1st, banner headlines. On ground and stone (10.9–12.4:1). Matches the gold star printed on the Encounter art.

tokens.name: brass-deep
tokens.usage: The bottom bevel and outer edge of brass buttons; pressed brass fill.

tokens.name: on-brass
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brass and brass-bright fills (9.2:1). Never white on brass.

tokens.name: jade
tokens.usage: Good outcomes and focus: 'You strike first', covered damage, lesson progress, the keyboard/controller focus ring. Text on stone (8.2:1). Named for the Jade Mountains.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Harm: damage taken, Armor penalties (-1), Not Allowed notes, You Have Perished. Text on stone (5.9:1) and stone-raised (5:1). Always paired with a sign or icon (−, heart, skull), never colour alone.

tokens.name: stat-hp
tokens.usage: The HP heart on Enemy and Dragon cards and in Result sums.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Reading surfaces: coach tips, the glossary entry pop-up, rulebook pages, the Unspent XP question. A dim, warm paper so it does not glare in a dark room.

tokens.name: paper-ink
tokens.usage: Text on paper (11.7:1).

tokens.name: paper-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and rules on paper (5.6:1).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind dialogs, the glossary, the menu and the region banner.

tokens.name: card-frame
tokens.usage: The outer frame and title band of every Mage, Key and Encounter card.

tokens.name: card-ribbon
tokens.usage: The stat ribbon under a card's title (cost, XP): a leather tone that bridges brass and stone.

tokens.name: stat-plate
tokens.usage: The dark plates behind card numerals. Card numbers are never set directly on an Ether field.

tokens.name: ether-lapis
tokens.usage: Card field of the Ether marked by the drop (blue today). Parchment on it is 4.5:1; keep figures on stat-plate.

tokens.name: ether-lapis-bright
tokens.usage: Highlighted drop-Ether figure pill (an upgraded or chosen value).

tokens.name: ether-ochre
tokens.usage: Card field of the Ether marked by the bolt (gold today). Too light for parchment text (2.2:1): text on it is on-brass.

tokens.name: ether-ochre-bright
tokens.usage: Highlighted bolt-Ether figure pill; text on it is on-brass.

tokens.name: ether-amethyst
tokens.usage: Card field of the Ether marked by the spark (violet today). Parchment on it is 4.8:1.

tokens.name: ether-amethyst-bright
tokens.usage: Highlighted spark-Ether figure pill.

tokens.name: ether-cinnabar
tokens.usage: Card field of the Ether marked by the flame (red today). Parchment on it is 4.5:1.

tokens.name: ether-cinnabar-bright
tokens.usage: Highlighted flame-Ether figure pill.

tokens.name: region-jade
tokens.usage: Region 1, Jade Mountains: the ground wash, the banner rule, the region medallion ring.

tokens.name: region-marsh
tokens.usage: Region 2, Living Marshes: as region-jade.

tokens.name: region-basin
tokens.usage: Region 3, Burning Basin: as region-jade.

tokens.name: region-gath
tokens.usage: Region 4, Forest of Gath: as region-jade.

tokens.name: region-lair
tokens.usage: The Final Journey and the dragon's lair: as region-jade. Proposed; tune per dragon if each lair is painted differently.

styles.name: banner
styles.usage: Region banner, Victory/Defeat headline. Uppercase. brass-bright on stone. One per screen.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Top-bar screen title and dialog titles. Title case, not caps.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Panel headings (Result, Prepare), Encounter names, leaderboard dragon names.

styles.name: card-name
styles.usage: Mage Card titles, uppercase, up to two lines in a 26pt band. 11px is the floor: today MOTIVATED FLIGHT wraps at about 7pt on a phone.

styles.name: numeral-xl
styles.usage: Score, Key Card Level, Dragon HP rows. Tabular figures.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Card figures on stat-plate, Result sums, Enemy stat shapes.

styles.name: numeral-sm
styles.usage: Top-bar counters (deck, held, discard), card cost and XP on the ribbon, chips.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Slot headers and column heads, uppercase. parchment-muted at rest, brass when the slot is the target.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Four Regions lie between you and the dragon.
styles.usage: Panel copy, coach tips, rulebook paragraphs. Max 60 characters a line.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Night Travel: Boost is reduced by Initiative
styles.usage: Encounter effect text, table rows, secondary panel copy.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Hold a card to see its other Levels.
styles.usage: Fine print and hints. The smallest live text in the game; nothing below 12px except card-name.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-number gap, numeral pill padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a set, chip padding, label-to-content.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inner padding of panels and buttons; gap between buttons.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen gutter inside the safe area; gap between the Encounter card and the tray.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between panel sections; banner padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between major regions of a screen (rare in landscape).

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Physical cards (Mage, Key, Encounter, Dragon): cards are cut paper, so they get rounded corners. Nothing else does.

tokens.name: radius-plate
tokens.usage: Stat plates and numeral pills on cards.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Counter chips and the HP-damage token in Result only.

chamfer.note: Corner cuts for everything that is carved stone rather than paper: panels, buttons, tabs, banners. In Godot: StyleBoxFlat with corner_radius = the value and corner_detail = 1.

tokens.name: chamfer-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, tabs, small buttons, slot wells.

tokens.name: chamfer-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and panels: the default cut.

tokens.name: chamfer-lg
tokens.usage: The Action Set tray, dialogs, the region banner ends.

borderWidth.note: Stone is etched: an outer dark line plus a 1px inner light line, never one flat coloured border.

tokens.name: border-etch
tokens.usage: The inner highlight line (parchment at 10%) on top of every stone surface.

tokens.name: border-edge
tokens.usage: The edge line of panels and unselected controls.

tokens.name: border-select
tokens.usage: Selected tab, target slot, chosen card: brass.

size.note: Sizes are phone points (CSS px). For a Godot project with a 720px-tall base viewport stretched to a ~390pt-tall phone, multiply by 1.85.

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Smallest hit area for anything tappable, including the menu and the counters' info taps.

tokens.name: topbar-height
tokens.usage: The top bar, inside the safe area.

tokens.name: action-height
tokens.usage: The bottom action row: Fuse, Divert, Play.

tokens.name: card-width
tokens.usage: A Mage Card in the tray on a 390pt-tall phone (the current cards are about 95pt). Height follows 5:7. Five figure rows at 16pt plus a two-line name is the most the card holds at this size.

tokens.name: shadow-slab
tokens.usage: Stone buttons, tabs and panels: a carved slab sitting on the table.

tokens.name: shadow-slab-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed stone button: the bevel collapses.

tokens.name: shadow-brass
tokens.usage: Brass primary buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-well
tokens.usage: Sunken slots and wells.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards lying on the table or lifted into a slot.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: A card being dragged, held, or inspected.

tokens.name: opacity-region-wash
tokens.usage: Strength of the region-* glow over ground.

tokens.name: opacity-out-of-play
tokens.usage: Cards out of play, together with full desaturation.
